story_type: fighter jets in formation over a beach airshow
hook: A NASA fighter painted like the flag, wing to wing over the ocean.
narration: A NASA fighter painted like the American flag, wing to wing over the Pacific.
October twenty twenty six. The Pacific Airshow at Huntington Beach, one of the largest aviation events in the country.
NASA flew two of its research jets in the show, an F/A-18 and an F-15.
Formation pilots hold position off a reference point on the lead jet, with constant tiny corrections.
The controller cleared them in with four words. NASA, the box is yours.
[short pause] The box is the block of sky over the water saved for the show, and they ran it pass after pass.
outcome: After the last pass, the NASA fighters turned north past show center and headed back to base.
title: NASA fighters over Huntington Beach
description:
NASA's F/A-18 and F-15 research aircraft, along with NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman's F-5s, flew in the 2026 Pacific Airshow in Huntington Beach, California, Oct. 2 to 4, 2026.
